answer: Splitting into 3 separate vaults requires a separate funded raven account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. The violet explorer makes public the whole merge tree. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
